examples:
Lists all ARO-HCP clusters in the specified resource group.
Omit `-ResourceGroupName` to list every cluster in the subscription.

Lists every `ExternalAuth` configured on the cluster.
A cluster typically has a single external auth that configures the external OIDC identity provider.
Lists all node pools belonging to cluster `myCluster`.

Lists the installable node-pool patch versions for the region, enabled-only and sorted ascending by semver (disabled versions are hidden).
This default view is equivalent to `-NodePool`; use `Select-Object -Last 1` to pick the highest.

$cpOperators = @{
    'cluster-api-azure'        = 'myCluster-cp-cluster-api-azure'
    'control-plane'            = 'myCluster-cp-control-plane'
    'cloud-controller-manager' = 'myCluster-cp-cloud-controller-manager'
    'ingress'                  = 'myCluster-cp-ingress'
    'disk-csi-driver'          = 'myCluster-cp-disk-csi-driver'
    'file-csi-driver'          = 'myCluster-cp-file-csi-driver'
    'image-registry'           = 'myCluster-cp-image-registry'
    'cloud-network-config'     = 'myCluster-cp-cloud-network-config'
    'kms'                      = 'myCluster-cp-kms'
}
$dpOperators = @{
    'disk-csi-driver' = 'myCluster-dp-disk-csi-driver'
    'file-csi-driver' = 'myCluster-dp-file-csi-driver'
    'image-registry'  = 'myCluster-dp-image-registry'
}
$smi    = 'myCluster-service-managed-identity'
$subnet = '/subscriptions/xxxxxxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx/resourceGroups/myResourceGroup/providers/Microsoft.Network/virtualNetworks/customer-vnet/subnets/customer-subnet-1'
$nsg    = '/subscriptions/xxxxxxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx/resourceGroups/myResourceGroup/providers/Microsoft.Network/networkSecurityGroups/customer-nsg'
$vnetIntSubnet = '/subscriptions/xxxxxxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx/resourceGroups/myResourceGroup/providers/Microsoft.Network/virtualNetworks/customer-vnet/subnets/customer-vnet-integration-subnet'

New-AzRedHatOpenShiftHcpCluster -Name myCluster -ResourceGroupName myResourceGroup -Location westeurope `
  -VersionId '4.22' -VersionChannelGroup 'stable' `
  -NetworkType 'OVNKubernetes' -NetworkPodCidr '10.128.0.0/14' -NetworkServiceCidr '172.30.0.0/16' `
  -NetworkMachineCidr '10.0.0.0/16' -NetworkHostPrefix 23 `
  -ApiVisibility Public -IngressType Public -PlatformOutboundType LoadBalancer `
  -PlatformManagedResourceGroup myCluster-managed `
  -PlatformSubnetId $subnet -PlatformNetworkSecurityGroupId $nsg -PlatformVnetIntegrationSubnetId $vnetIntSubnet `
  -UserAssignedIdentityControlPlaneOperator $cpOperators `
  -UserAssignedIdentityDataPlaneOperator $dpOperators `
  -UserAssignedIdentityServiceManagedIdentity $smi `
  -KmVaultName mykeyvault -ActiveKeyName etcd-encryption-key `
  -ActiveKeyVersion 1234567890abcdef1234567890abcdef -KmVisibility Public `
  -ClusterImageRegistryState Enabled -Tag @{ env = 'dev' }

$clientProfile = @(
    @{
        ComponentName                = 'console'
        ComponentAuthClientNamespace = 'openshift-console'
        ClientId                     = 'xxxxxxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx'
        Type                         = 'Confidential'
    }
)

New-AzRedHatOpenShiftHcpExternalAuth -ResourceGroupName myResourceGroup `
  -HcpOpenShiftClusterName myCluster -Name myExternalAuth `
  -IssuerUrl 'https://login.microsoftonline.com/xxxxxxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx/v2.0' `
  -IssuerAudience @('xxxxxxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx') `
  -ClientProfile $clientProfile -UsernameClaim 'email' -GroupClaim 'groups'

Creates an `ExternalAuth` that points the cluster's kube-apiserver at the given Entra OIDC issuer and maps the `email`/`groups` token claims to users and groups.
The OpenShift web console (`console`/`openshift-console`) must be a `Confidential` client, so the resource provisions to `AwaitingSecret` until its client secret is supplied in-cluster.

$subnetId = "/subscriptions/xxxxxxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx/resourceGroups/myResourceGroup/providers/Microsoft.Network/virtualNetworks/customer-vnet/subnets/customer-subnet-1"

New-AzRedHatOpenShiftHcpNodePool -ResourceGroupName myResourceGroup -HcpOpenShiftClusterName myCluster `
  -Name mynodepool -Location eastus `
  -VersionId '4.22.18' -VersionChannelGroup 'stable' `
  -PlatformVMSize 'Standard_D8s_v3' -Replica 2 `
  -PlatformSubnetId $subnetId `
  -OSDiskSizeGiB 128 -OSDiskStorageAccountType StandardSSD_LRS -OSDiskType Managed -AutoRepair

Creates a node pool named `mynodepool` on cluster `myCluster` with 2 replicas, `Standard_D8s_v3` VMs, and a 128 GiB managed OS disk.
The node pool `-VersionId` must be a concrete `X.Y.Z` patch version (the RP does not resolve a bare `X.Y` for node pools).

Patches a non-identity field (resource tags) on an existing cluster.
Because no operator-identity parameters are supplied, the request is forwarded unchanged with no GET-merge.

Patches the node pool `mynodepool` to run 3 replicas.
This is an asynchronous (LRO) PATCH.
